architecture_layers.name: Network Traffic Input
architecture_layers.purpose: Provide network traffic observations used by the NetVision forecasting pipeline.

architecture_layers.name: Temporal Representation
architecture_layers.purpose: Aggregate network-flow observations into the selected 5-minute temporal representation.

architecture_layers.name: ML Forecasting
architecture_layers.purpose: Use the XGBoost + Random Forest-SMOTE ensemble to estimate future attack probability.

architecture_layers.name: World Model
architecture_layers.purpose: Use the current traffic state and transition model to estimate multi-step future attack probabilities.

architecture_layers.name: XAI
architecture_layers.purpose: Use probability-space SHAP to explain the contribution of model features to the ML prediction.

architecture_layers.name: MITRE ATT&CK Mapping
architecture_layers.purpose: Interpret observable network behavior as candidate MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

architecture_layers.name: Unified System Output
architecture_layers.purpose: Combine forecasting, world-model, XAI, and MITRE interpretation into a structured response.

ML.question_answered: What is the predicted probability of a future attack?

World_Model.question_answered: How does the estimated attack state evolve over future time horizons?

XAI.question_answered: Why did the ML model make this prediction?
XAI.method: Probability-space SHAP with weighted ensemble contributions

MITRE.question_answered: What known adversarial behavior is the observed traffic pattern consistent with?

design_constraints: MITRE mapping must use behavioral evidence.
Individual ML features must not directly determine a technique.
Multiple traffic signals should support a technique candidate.
Only features present in the finalized 138-feature schema may be used.
MITRE confidence represents evidence strength, not certainty.
Network-flow telemetry alone cannot prove malicious intent.
SHAP and MITRE must remain separate interpretation layers.
Insufficient evidence must not force a technique assignment.
